episodeTitle.en: M&A, competition, pricing, and investing | Julia Schottenstein (dbt Labs)
episodeTitle.zh: 并购、竞争、定价与投资 | 朱莉娅·肖滕斯坦（dbt Labs）

guestBioOfficial.en: Julia Schottenstein is a product lead at dbt Labs, a data transformation company, and an active angel investor in data and infrastructure startups. She first got excited about dbt in 2019 when she was a VC at NEA and decided to make the leap from investor to operator by joining dbt Labs. She also co-hosts the dbt Labs Analytics Engineering Podcast, a show about data trends that impact analytics engineers’ work. In today’s episode, we discuss: • Advice for founders hoping to improve their M&A outcome
guestBioOfficial.zh: 朱莉娅·肖滕斯坦是数据转型公司 dbt Labs 的产品负责人，也是数据和基础设施初创企业的活跃天使投资人。2019 年，她在 NEA 担任风投时，首次对 dbt 产生了浓厚兴趣，随后决定从投资者转变为运营者，加入 dbt Labs。她还联合主持 dbt Labs 分析工程播客，探讨影响分析工程师工作的数据趋势。在本期节目中，我们讨论了：• 希望提升并购成果的创始人建议

title.en: M&A, competition, pricing, and investing | Julia Schottenstein (dbt Labs)
title.zh: 并购、竞争、定价与投资 | 朱莉娅·肖滕斯坦（dbt Labs）

summary.en: Julia reframes M&A as the disciplined practice of creating "plan Bs" so you always have optionality with potential buyers. She advises founders to become strategically unavoidable to a small set of buyers by leaning into a genuine competitive advantage without burning bridges. The episode offers a pragmatic playbook for early M&A thinking.
summary.zh: 茱莉亚把并购重新定义为一种有纪律的"准备 B 计划"的实践，让你始终对潜在收购方保有选择权。她建议创始人，通过发挥真正的竞争优势、又不伤和气地切入，使自己在少数几个买家眼中变得"难以忽视"。本期提供了一份务实的早期并购思路与打法。
